subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin add only an opt-in unknown-group auto-leave policy now, while deferring the broader group-join notification and agent-callable leave surfaces to the cross-channel design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489?
rationale: Automatic departure changes external account membership and the proposed notification/tool surfaces expose sensitive metadata or destructive capabilities; code inspection cannot choose those permanent product and authorization boundaries.

options.title: Ship narrow auto-leave
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default WhatsApp plugin policy based on `channels.whatsapp.groups`, with account-scoped self-add detection, idempotent departure, documentation, and live proof; defer hooks and manual actions.

options.title: Design group admission together
options.body: Treat this as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489 and define a shared approval, notification, rejection, and optional departure model before implementing channel-specific behavior.

options.title: Keep deny-only behavior
options.body: Retain message denial without automatic membership changes and document manual WhatsApp cleanup as the supported security boundary.

recommendation.title: Ship narrow auto-leave
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default WhatsApp plugin policy based on `channels.whatsapp.groups`, with account-scoped self-add detection, idempotent departure, documentation, and live proof; defer hooks and manual actions.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans repository product direction, security defaults, and the official WhatsApp plugin contract, and steipete is the documented maintainer who previously reviewed this item.
